Aggregate

The Connector for Android's SQLite, driver name android.

A driver over Android's SQLiteDatabase, for Android 9 (API 28) and later.
Attribute<T>

A many-to-many relation through a pivot table, such as a user's roles through role_user: Laravel's BelongsToMany.

The clause a binding belongs to.

Casts
Factory for the built-in casts.
CastSerializer<T>

A read-only source of string configuration values addressed by dot-separated keys.
Connection

Receives the query and transaction events of a connection family.

Maps connection names to query factories, so a model reaches the database named by its connectionName().

The handle of an installed default resolver; closing it restores the previous default.
Connector
Builds the Connection, query factory and schema builder of one kind of database.
ConstraintDetails
Reads the constraint name and column names of a constraint failure.
Cursor

One page of rows read by key position, with the cursors that lead to the pages around it, as PageQueries.cursorPaginate(int, Cursor) returns it; Laravel's CursorPaginator without the URL and HTML parts.

Assertions on the rows of a database, in the style of Laravel's assertDatabaseHas.
DatabaseConfig
The set of named connection configs and the name of the default one.

DatabaseFamily
Groups databases whose SQL and error codes behave alike.
DatabaseManager
The entry point that builds named connections from a DatabaseConfig the first time each is used and hands out their Connection, QueryFactory, Schema and Migrator.Builder.

Keeps the migrations table through a Schema and its connection.

DataSourceConnectionProvider

DatePart
The part of a date or time a Where.DateBased condition compares.

Driver
Opens sessions on one database for Diwan Database.
DriverCapability
Names an optional feature a driver's database supports, as reported by DriverInfo.
DriverException

DriverFailureKind
Classifies a DriverException so the core can react without knowing the database.
DriverFailureMessages
Builds the message of a driver failure from its SQL state, vendor code, kinds and result code name.
DriverInfo

DriverManagerDataSource
A data source that opens a new connection through DriverManager on every call.
DriverSession
Runs statements and transaction commands on one physical connection.
EloquentBuilder<T>
A query on one model's table that returns models: Laravel's Eloquent builder over the core query builder.
EloquentException
The parent of every failure the model layer reports, such as a model that was not found or a relation that is not defined.
EnvConfigSource
A configuration source over environment variables.
Expression
A piece of SQL written into a statement exactly as given and never bound: count(*) in a select list or now() as a value in a query, or a default value computed by the database in a schema.
ForeignIdColumnDefinition
The column BlueprintKeys.foreignId(String), BlueprintHelpers.foreignUuid(String) or BlueprintHelpers.foreignUlid(String) adds: a key column that can point at another table's key in one call, table.foreignId("user_id").constrained().
ForeignKeyAction
What the database does to referencing rows when the referenced row is deleted or its key changes.
ForeignKeyCheckException
Thrown when rows break a foreign key after a schema change that the database could not check as it ran, such as a SQLite table rebuild.
ForeignKeyDefinition
A foreign key of a Blueprint, with Laravel's chained calls: table.foreign("user_id").references("id").on("users").cascadeOnDelete().
ForeignKeyInfo
One foreign key of a table as the database reports it, from Schema.foreignKeys(String).
ForeignKeysOffRequiredException
Thrown when a schema change inside a transaction needs foreign key enforcement off, which the database can only switch before the transaction starts.
ForeignKeyViolationException
Reports a statement that broke a foreign key constraint, as classified by the driver.
HasMany<R>
A one-to-many relation whose related rows hold the key, such as a post's comments: Laravel's HasMany.
HasManyThrough<R>
A has-many-through relation: the far parent has many related rows through an intermediate model, such as a country with many posts through its users.
HasOne<R>
A one-to-one relation whose related row holds the key, such as a user's profile: Laravel's HasOne.
HasOneOrMany<R,S>
A relation whose related rows hold the key: the related table has a foreign key column that points at a column of the parent, its local key.
HasOneOrManyThrough<R,S>
A relation that reaches the related rows through an intermediate table: the far parent owns through rows, and each through row owns related rows.
HasOneThrough<R>
A one-to-one relation that reaches the related row through an intermediate model, such as a mechanic's owner through the car: Laravel's HasOneThrough.
Having
One condition of a having clause, as the Builder records it and a QueryGrammar compiles it.
Having.Basic
A column compared with a value.
Having.Between
A column between two values.
Having.Nested
A group of having conditions in parentheses.
Having.NotNull
A column that is not null.
Having.Null
A column that is null.
Having.Raw
Trusted SQL written as given.
Identifiers
Quotes SQL identifiers; the one place where both the query grammar and the schema grammar escape a name.
IndexInfo
One index of a table as the database reports it, from Schema.indexes(String).
Inflector
Guesses English plurals and snake case names for table and column names.
Instants
Converts moments for a BlueprintColumns.instant(java.lang.String) column: whole microseconds since the epoch on SQLite, timestamptz on PostgreSQL.
Internal
Marks a type or member that is not part of the public API and may change in any release.
InvalidCastException
Signals that a cast could not be parsed, applied or reversed for a model attribute.
InvalidRelationException
Signals that a model class's relations() map failed its one-time check.
JdbcConnectionProvider
Supplies the JDBC connections a JdbcDriver works on, and takes them back.
JdbcDriver
Implements Driver over JDBC connections from a JdbcConnectionProvider.
JoinClause
The conditions of one join, a port of Laravel's JoinClause: a Builder whose where clause compiles after on.
JsonCodec
Converts between JSON text and plain Java values.
JsonException
Signals that text is not valid JSON or that a value cannot be written as JSON.
LayeredConfigSource
A configuration source that asks several sources in priority order.
LazyLoadingViolationException
Signals a lazy load while lazy loading is prevented, a port of Laravel's LazyLoadingViolationException.
LengthAwarePage
One page of rows with the total number of matching rows, as PageQueries.paginate(int, int) returns it; Laravel's LengthAwarePaginator without the URL and HTML parts.
ListenerFailedException
Reports that a listener failed after its statement had already succeeded.
LockStrength
How strongly a locked select holds the rows it reads.
LockWait
What a locked select does when another transaction already holds a conflicting lock.
LockWaitGuard

LockWaitOption
Parses the lock_wait connection option into a number of milliseconds.

ManagerListener
Receives the events of a DatabaseManager, as opposed to the events of one connection.
MapConfigSource
A configuration source over values written in code.

Migration

MigrationChecksum
Computes the checksum a Migration can declare through Migration.checksum().

MigrationChecksumException.Mismatch
One migration whose declared checksum differs from the recorded one.
MigrationEntry
One row of the migrations table: a migration that ran, the batch it ran in and the checksum recorded for it, if any.
MigrationEvent
Describes one migration being run or undone, for MigrationListener.
MigrationFailedException
Reports that a migration failed, with the work that finished before it.
MigrationFailedException.Direction
Which method of the migration failed.
MigrationFailedException.Phase
Which step of a migration failed.
MigrationListener
Observes what a Migrator does, as Laravel's migration events do, plus a failure event.
MigrationLock

MigrationRepository
Records which migrations ran and in which batch.
MigrationResult
What the Migrator did with one migration.
MigrationResult.Outcome
What happened to a migration.
MigrationsEvent

MigrationStatus

MigrationStatus.State
Whether a migration ran.
Migrator
Runs migrations and rolls them back, as Laravel's migrator does.
Migrator.Builder
Collects what a Migrator needs and checks it before anything runs.
MissingMigrationsException
Refuses a rollback or reset that would reach records whose migrations the migrator was not given.
Model
The base class of every model: one row of one table, with Laravel's Eloquent persistence.
ModelClock
The clock models read their timestamps from, truncated to whole microseconds, the precision every supported database keeps.
ModelCollection<T>
A read-only list of models, with Laravel's Eloquent collection helpers.
ModelEvents<T>
The listener registrar of one model class, reached through ModelQuery.events().
ModelNotFoundException
Thrown when a lookup that must find a model finds none, with Laravel's message: "No query results for model [app.User] 1, 2", or "No query results for model [app.User]." when no ids were asked for.
ModelObserver<T>
A set of model event hooks in one class, registered with ModelEvents.observe(org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.ModelObserver<? super T>).
ModelPage<T>
One page of models with the total count, from EloquentBuilder.paginate(int, int).
ModelQuery<T>

ModelSeeding
Helpers that join seeders to models.
MorphEagerOptions

MorphMany<R>
A polymorphic one-to-many relation, such as a post's comments: Laravel's MorphMany.
MorphMap

MorphOne<R>

MorphTo<R>
The inverse of a morph-one or morph-many relation: the model this relation is built on, the child, holds a type column and an id column, and together they point at an owner of any model class, such as a comment's post or video.
MorphToMany<R>
A polymorphic many-to-many relation, such as the tags of a post or a video: Laravel's MorphToMany.

MultipleRecordsFoundException

Order

Order.Column

Order.Raw

Order.Sub

PropertiesConfigSource

Relation<R,S>

RowCursor

RowLock

Schema
Creates, changes and inspects tables, as Laravel's Schema facade does.
SchemaGrammar

SchemaQuery
A query a grammar returns for the schema builder to run, with its binding values.
Scope
A query constraint that applies to every query on a model, as Laravel's Scope.
SearchWhere
An escaped text search: a column that contains, starts with or ends with a literal text.
SearchWhere.Anchor

SeedContext

Seeder

SeedRunner

SimpleModelPage<T>
One page of models without a total count, from EloquentBuilder.simplePaginate(int, int).
SimplePage
One page of rows and whether more follow, as PageQueries.simplePaginate(int, int) returns it; Laravel's Paginator without the URL and HTML parts.
SoftDeletingScope
Hides soft-deleted rows: adds deleted_at is null on the model's qualified deleted-at column.
SQLiteConnector
The Connector for SQLite, driver name sqlite.
SQLiteProcessor

SQLiteQuery

SQLiteQueryGrammar
Compiles queries into SQLite SQL, a hand port of Laravel's Illuminate\Database\Query\Grammars\SQLiteGrammar.

SQLiteSchemaGrammar
Writes SQLite SQL, following Laravel's SQLiteGrammar.

TransactionPhase

TransactionScope

Union
One query joined to its builder by union or union all.
UniqueConstraintViolationException
Reports a statement that broke a unique or primary key constraint, as classified by the driver.
UniqueIdKind
The kind of unique string id a model generates for its primary key on insert.
UniqueIds

UnregisteredModelException

ViewInfo
One view as the database reports it, from Schema.getViews().
Where
One condition of a where clause, as the Builder records it and a QueryGrammar compiles it.
Where.Basic
A column compared with a value: "a" > ?.
Where.Between
A column between two values, both ends included.
Where.BetweenColumns
A column between two other columns.
Where.Column
Two columns compared with each other.
Where.DateBased
A part of a date or time column compared with a value: date("a") = ?.
Where.In
A column in a list of values; an empty list never matches.
Where.Like
A like or not like match.
Where.Nested
A group of conditions in parentheses.
Where.NotIn
A column not in a list of values; an empty list always matches.
Where.NotNull
A column that is not null.
Where.Null
A column that is null.
Where.NullSafeEquals
A comparison that treats two nulls as equal.
Where.Raw
Trusted SQL written as given.
Where.ValueBetween
A value between two columns.
WhereExists

WhereInSub
A column in, or not in, the rows a subquery returns: "a" in (select ...).

WhereSub

WhereSubValue
The single value a subquery returns, compared with a value: (select ...) > ?.
